$comment: Versioned performance budgets for CircleUp. Update only with measurement evidence.

environmentVariance.description: Standardized environment variance considerations for reproducible CI gating without flaky dependencies
environmentVariance.isolation: In-memory deterministic fixtures to eliminate network and live database jitter
environmentVariance.notes: Budgets represent upper tolerance ceilings (p99 bounds) designed to catch algorithmic and serialization regressions without false positives under virtualized CI scheduling.

api.$comment: Indexer query and serialization budgets measured against deterministic fixture datasets

circleList.$comment: Max DB query time for GET /circles with 50 rows
Max JSON response size for 50 circles

bundle.$comment: Next.js page JS budgets (gzipped). Measured with `next build` output. Exceptions documented below.

homePage.$comment: Includes React runtime and shared chunks

createPage.$comment: stellar-sdk adds ~15 KB gzipped; exception granted until tree-shaking is implemented

$exception.stellar-sdk: stellar-sdk cannot be tree-shaken without bundler config changes; tracked in issue #todo

render.$comment: Component and data preparation time budgets in ms measured in Node.js runtime. These are ceiling values, not targets.

payload.$comment: Wire payload size budgets (uncompressed) for the initial circle list in different states
